beats.care: If you rent, expect pricier tankers and possible supply cuts. Fixing taps and saving water now actually helps.
beats.what: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy told officials to save every drop, warning that the next eight months will be critical for water and power.
beats.why: About 215 mandals face drought-like conditions. In seven percent of Hyderabad district, groundwater is now more than 20 metres down.

cards.body: Ground Water Department data shows the deepest level in the district at 34.99 m near Ameerpet. The state has asked the Centre for a ₹20,000 crore package. A water-saving campaign is planned after Dasara, and power-heavy work may be postponed.

cards.note: Share of Hyderabad district at each depth, Ground Water Department data via Telangana Today.
cards.title: How deep is Hyderabad's groundwater?

cards.body: When water sits deeper, homes and apartments drill deeper borewells, which costs more and drains the ground faster. Experts quoted by Telangana Today expect an acute shortage in the coming months.

cards.q: Why are officials worried about the coming months?
cards.why: Weak rains mean less water soaked into the ground, so supplies could run short when demand peaks in summer.
